lines.text: When something isn't working, your Briefing now says so in plain words; serious things come as one push a day.
Settings › About has Repair and Copy report. If the app ever fails to start, a small panel offers Repair.
The chat says when your plan's limit is holding a reply and until when; the Briefing shows the right day after midnight.
Music's first sync now finishes for a large library, and Music, Podcasts and Guitar no longer use the old server.
